cells: Pigsfield: One Stop for All Educational Resources
We are your gateway to Every Free but Best Educational Resource.
Education is your Right. It must be free.

The current educational infrastructure is highly commercialized. From primary schooling to advanced doctoral research, the system frequently prioritizes financial capability over intellectual curiosity. When education becomes a transaction, the true essence of learning is lost.

Pigsfield is built on a singular, uncompromising principle: high-quality education must be universally accessible and absolutely free. We are a volunteer-driven platform dedicated to dismantling the financial and systemic barriers to learning. We don't sell guarantees; we provide the resources for you to build your own capability.

Driven by a dedicated team of volunteers, our objective is clear: establish a robust educational framework in India first, scaling globally within two years. We are available, dedicated, and working continuously to build this infrastructure.
Change doesn't come from cursing the system, but from building alternatives.
Foundation to Frontier (LKG to PhD): Unrestricted access to academic resources across all levels of formal education.
Competitive Excellence: Structured, high-quality guidance for UPSC, RAS, SSC, and other critical examinations.
Vocational & Skill Development: Practical, real-world skills, recognizing that true empowerment extends beyond traditional degrees.
